requirements.title: Display catalog items with filters and pagination
requirements.statement: The system must retrieve paginated catalog items based on brand ID and type ID filters, ignoring filters if the provided ID is 0, and display all relevant item details in a list format.

requirements.title: Retrieve and display detailed catalog item information
requirements.statement: The system must retrieve a specific catalog item by its ID, eagerly loading associated catalog brand and catalog type information, and display all item details including stock and pricing.

requirements.title: Manage catalog item lifecycle
requirements.statement: The system must support creating a new catalog item by providing all necessary details (Name, Description, Brand, Type, Price, Stock, Thresholds, Image), updating an existing item, and removing an item from the service/database.

requirements.title: Manage stock availability records
requirements.statement: The system must allow for creating or updating stock records for a specific item on a given date, either by creating a new record or overwriting an existing one, and must be able to query the available stock for a specific item and date.

requirements.title: Calculate final catalog item price with active discounts
requirements.statement: The final displayed price for a catalog item must be calculated by multiplying the original price by (1 - discount percentage), based on currently active discounts checked against the date.

requirements.title: Manage application configuration securely
requirements.statement: Configuration values, including database connection strings and secrets, must not be hardcoded in container packages, and sensitive credentials should be managed securely via environment variables or configuration providers.

requirements.title: Support dynamic view switching based on device
requirements.statement: The system must dynamically switch the presentation view between 'Mobile' and 'Desktop' based on whether the incoming request is detected as mobile.

requirements.title: Display application session and machine info
requirements.statement: The application footer must display the server's machine name and the time the current user session began.

requirements.title: Handle application initialization and data seeding
requirements.statement: Upon startup, the application must initialize core catalog data by setting up database schema (including sequences) and populating catalog types, brands, discounts, and initial stock levels from known data sources.

requirements.title: Support user authentication via Azure Active Directory
requirements.statement: The application must conditionally display login/logout controls, supporting authentication flow through Azure Active Directory.

requirements.title: Handle image uploads for catalog items
requirements.statement: The system must support uploading an image when creating or editing a catalog item, and the system must use an ImageService to process this image, linking the filename to the catalog item.

requirements.title: Log application events for monitoring
requirements.statement: The logging system must capture contextual properties like 'activity' and 'requestinfo' and manage log files using a rolling file appender with specified limits and backup counts.

requirements.title: Maintain service availability and scaling configuration
requirements.statement: The containerized services must be configured to run across a defined number of instances as specified in deployment profiles.

phases.name: Phase 1: Catalog Data & Core Service Foundation
phases.goal: Establish the new Data Access Layer and Business Layer, successfully migrating the catalog service functionalities, including CRUD operations, discounts, and stock management.
exitCriteria: Catalog Item CRUD operations are fully functional in the new system.
Stock management and discount calculation logic are verified against legacy behavior.
Core entities (CatalogItem, CatalogBrand, CatalogType, DiscountItem, Stock) are persisted and retrieved correctly.

phases.name: Phase 2: Frontend Interface Modernization
phases.goal: Replace the primary legacy catalog web interfaces (WebForms and MVC) with Razor Pages, focusing on the main product listing and detail views.
exitCriteria: The new Razor Pages successfully display paginated catalog items with all required details.
Creation, editing, and deletion workflows for catalog items are live on the new presentation layer.
Dynamic features like view switching and UI elements are functional in the new frontend.

phases.name: Phase 3: Externalization and Cleanup
phases.goal: Migrate remaining services, finalize configuration hardening, and decommission the legacy codebase.
exitCriteria: All external integrations (e.g., authentication) are correctly routed or replaced.
Hardcoded configuration and secrets are fully externalized to the deployment environment.
The legacy system is retired after a verification period.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog CRUD via Service
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid CatalogItem object, when CreateCatalogItem is called, then a new CatalogItem is persisted with an auto-generated ID.
Given a valid CatalogItem ID, when FindCatalogItem is called, then the complete CatalogItem, including its Brand and Type, is returned.
Given a specific CatalogItem ID, when UpdateCatalogItem is called with valid data, then the item is marked as Modified and saved to the database.
Given a specific CatalogItem ID, when RemoveCatalogItem is called, then the item is successfully removed from the data source.
tasks.invariant: Catalog item data integrity must be maintained across all Create, Update, and Delete operations.
probes: Submit item with null Name => refused with validation error for Name
Attempt to update item with invalid Price format => refused with validation error for Price

needs.purpose: Error handling mechanism for CRUD failures

tasks.title: Implement Stock Management Logic
acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing stock record for an item and date, when CreateAvailableStock is called, then the AvailableStock is updated with the new quantity.
Given no stock record for an item and date, when CreateAvailableStock is called, then a new stock record is created and assigned a unique StockId.
Given an item ID and a date, when GetAvailableStock is called, then the correct AvailableStock value is returned, or 0 if no record exists.
tasks.invariant: Stock records must accurately reflect the latest recorded availability for a given item and date.
probes: Attempt to update stock with negative quantity => refused with validation error
Query stock for a date one day beyond the recorded range => returns 0

tasks.title: Implement Discount Pricing Logic
acceptanceCriteria: Given a catalog item with original price P and an active discount D%, when price calculation runs, then the final price is P * (1 - D%).
Given the current date is within the DiscountItem's Start and End dates, when GetDiscount is called, then the discount item is returned.
tasks.invariant: Price calculation must always reflect the active discount percentage derived from available DiscountItems.
probes: Calculate price when discount date is exactly one day before start date => no discount returned
Calculate price when discount date is exactly one day after end date => no discount returned

tasks.title: Migrate Configuration to Environment Variables
acceptanceCriteria: Given the container is deployed, when the ConnectionString is required, then it is sourced from an environment variable.
Given the container is deployed, when the post-logout redirect URI is required, then it is sourced from an environment variable.
tasks.invariant: No connection strings or critical configuration values must appear hardcoded in source files or container manifests.
probes: Check ServiceManifest.xml for hardcoded ConnectionString => it must not be present
Check ServiceManifest.xml for hardcoded PostLogoutRedirectURI => it must not be present

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Item API and Controller
acceptanceCriteria: Given request parameters pageIndex=2 and pageSize=10, when calling the Index action, then the service returns the second page of catalog items.
Given a valid ID, when calling the Details action, then the corresponding catalog item is returned, and all associated brand/type data is present.
Given request parameters for Create, when submitting a valid form, then the service successfully creates the item and redirects to Index.
Given a specific ID, when calling the Edit action, then the corresponding item is loaded, and Brand/Type dropdowns are pre-populated with existing values.
tasks.invariant: The presentation layer must accurately reflect the state of the catalog items retrieved from the business service.
probes: Request page index too large => returns an appropriate empty result set
Request ID for details page that does not exist => returns 404 NotFound

tasks.title: Implement Item Image Handling
acceptanceCriteria: Given a catalog item ID and a filename, when requesting the image via the dedicated endpoint, then the image file bytes are returned with the correct MIME type.
Given the ViewAzureStorage flag is true, when loading the Edit page, then an image upload interface is rendered.
Given an item is loaded, when AddUriPlaceHolder is called, then the PictureUri is correctly formed as /Pics/{Id}.png.
tasks.invariant: All references to catalog item images must resolve correctly via the dedicated URI mapping.
probes: Request image for ID that does not exist => returns 404 Not Found
Request image with file extension that is not supported => returns 404 Not Found

tasks.title: Finalize Application Startup and Telemetry
acceptanceCriteria: Given an HTTP request begins, when the application starts, then a 'WebApplication_BeginRequest' debug log entry is recorded.
Given the application starts, when registration occurs, then controllers and API controllers are correctly registered via Autofac.
Given a request arrives, when the system initializes, then the ActivityIdHelper ensures a unique ActivityId is available in the correlation manager.
Given a request arrives, when CatalogService is invoked, then the service correctly retrieves Brand and Type associations for the item.
tasks.invariant: Application startup must be consistent, setting up all necessary dependencies and telemetry hooks before handling any request.
probes: Simulate request without required context initialization => request fails gracefully
Attempt to access endpoint before service startup is complete => returns service unavailable
